description: Archive the owned Library resource bytes and metadata for use in scenes. Returns assetId/revisionId, capabilities, material/animation names and sockets. Repeating for identical content reuses the archive; it consumes workspace storage only once. Prefers the validated version for insertion; choose version=work to test the draft. Does not approve the asset visually.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Returned scene links open this workspace.

title: Pin an immutable Library revision
